quote: TDCA employs a contrastive labelconditioned generation approach, which fine-tunes LLMs to generate texts that not only accurately reflect each label in the sampled label combinations but also emulate the style of the original dataset.

We introduce a new multi-label data augmentation paradigm, Label Creative Generation (LCG), and within LCG, we propose Tail-Driven Conditional Augmentation (TDCA).
tasks: Other:Conditional Text Generation for Data Augmentation
outputs: synthetic texts generated conditioned on sampled label combinations for data augmentation
